column2: 一把普通的精钢镐头，可以用于开采紫铜
column3: An ordinary Steel pickaxe head; can be used to mine Copper.

column2: 一把紫铜镐头，开采能力有了大幅度加强
column3: A Copper pickaxe head — its mining power is greatly improved.

column2: 一把晶化合金钻头，即使是坚硬的冰块也可以迅速被刨开！
column3: A Crystallized Alloy drill bit — even hard Ice Blocks can be bored through in a flash!

column2:
虽然名字很唬人，但这些附着的灵魂唯一作用就是更快的收割绝音蕨。
[收割]技能视为高4级！
column3:
The name is intimidating, but the only thing these attached souls do is harvest Silent Fern faster.
[Harvest] skill counts as 4 levels higher!

column2: 相当锋利的斧头。不过面对百年柳木，依然需要较长的时间来砍伐。
column3: A rather sharp axe. Still, felling Century Willow takes it a fair while.

column2: 愈加锋利的斧头。砍伐百年柳木如吃饭一样简单了！
column3: An even sharper axe. Felling Century Willow is now as easy as eating a meal!

column3: Head (Inner) armor bonded from Gel and Moth Wings.

column3: Legs (Inner) armor bonded from Gel and Moth Wings.

column3: Feet (Inner) armor bonded from Gel and Moth Wings.

column3: Head (Inner) armor made from Aberrant Beast Hide.

column2: 由异兽皮制成的胸部内甲
column3: Chest (Inner) armor made from Aberrant Beast Hide.

column2: 由异兽皮制成的腿部内甲
column3: Legs (Inner) armor made from Aberrant Beast Hide.

column2: 由异兽皮制成的脚部内甲
column3: Feet (Inner) armor made from Aberrant Beast Hide.

column2: 由活性材料塑造成的头部内甲
column3: Head (Inner) armor shaped from Reactive material.

column2: 由活性材料塑造成的胸部内甲
column3: Chest (Inner) armor shaped from Reactive material.

column2: 由活性材料塑造成的腿部内甲
column3: Legs (Inner) armor shaped from Reactive material.

column2: 由活性材料塑造成的脚部内甲
column3: Feet (Inner) armor shaped from Reactive material.

column2: 湛蓝芦苇编织成的内甲，通过传导能量削弱一部分敌方的攻击。
column3: Inner armor woven from Deep Blue Reed; it conducts energy away to blunt part of the enemy's attack.

column2: 高能织料制成的内甲，内部能量可以部分用来补充体力。
column3: Inner armor of High-Energy Cloth; its stored energy can partly replenish your stamina.

column2: 黑森织料制成的内甲，贴身护甲暂时不会和兵器一样过时。
column3: Inner armor of Blackwood Cloth; unlike weapons, close-fitting armor won't go obsolete for a while yet.

column2: 极寒织料制成的内甲。附加词条也是防御：极寒织料的特性即是如此。
column3: Inner armor of Deepfrost Cloth. Its bonus stat is also defense — that's just how Deepfrost Cloth works.

column2: 极寒织料制成的内甲，附加词条也是防御：极寒织料的特性即是如此。
column3: Inner armor of Deepfrost Cloth; its bonus stat is also defense — that's just how Deepfrost Cloth works.

column2: 幻符织料制成的内甲。本来应该是隐身的，可惜外甲还是可以被看见……
column3: Inner armor of Phantom Rune Cloth. It's supposed to be invisible — shame the outer armor can still be seen…

column2: 密林织料制成的内甲。鲜红如血，在必要时候也能转化出血液用于恢复！
column3: Inner armor of Deepwood Cloth. Blood-red in color, it can even convert into blood for healing when needed!

column2: 青冰棉制成的内甲。侧重敏捷，也提供部分恢复和一丁点对宝石的吸收效果。
column3: Inner armor of Blue Frost Cotton. Favors Agility, and also gives some recovery and a tiny bit of gem absorption.

column2: 制式的铁制头盔外壳，因阻挡视野会略微影响攻击速度
column3: A standard-issue Iron helmet shell; it blocks your view and slightly lowers Attack Speed.

column2: 制式的铁制胸甲外壳
column3: A standard-issue Iron chestplate shell.

column2: 制式的铁制腿甲外壳
column3: A standard-issue Iron greaves shell.

column2: 制式的铁制战靴外壳，会略微影响行动
column3: A standard-issue Iron boots shell; it slightly hampers movement.

column2: A1级盔甲，轻便而坚硬
column3: A1-tier armor — light and hard.

column2: 有一定的毒性，但在荒兽海中显得无关紧要。
column3: Somewhat toxic, but that hardly matters in the Wildbeast Sea.

column2: A6级盔甲，和活性内甲一样可以完美贴合身体。
column3: A6-tier armor; like Reactive inner armor, it fits the body perfectly.

column2: A8级盔甲，可以对能量起到缓冲作用。
column3: A8-tier armor; it cushions against energy.

column2: B1级盔甲，可以对能量起到缓冲作用。
column3: B1-tier armor; it cushions against energy.

column2: B5级盔甲，燕岗城护卫长的制式装备。
column3: B5-tier armor, standard-issue gear of Yangang City's captain of the guard.

column2: 真的非常冷。不过黑森织料和火灵幻海会保护喵可的！
column3: Seriously cold. But Blackwood Cloth and the Flame Spirit Sea will keep Neko safe!

column2: 它本身是几乎透明的……外甲不能单独穿戴！想什么呢！
column3: It's nearly transparent on its own… the outer armor can't be worn by itself! What were you thinking!

column2: 从魂晶开始，因为需要更厚的装甲来发挥材料的潜力，它们的消耗翻倍了！(经验也翻倍了)
column3: Starting from Soul Crystal, thicker armor is needed to draw out the material's potential, so their cost is doubled! (XP is doubled too.)

column2: 战场气息是叠易伤的一把好手。直观的体现就是普攻倍率。
column3: Battlefield Aura is great at stacking vulnerability. In practice that shows up as Basic Attack Multiplier.

column2: 让敌人因为自己的精血气息受到震慑……换谁谁不怕哇！
column3: Its aura of refined blood cows the enemy… who wouldn't be scared, honestly!

column2: 金属残片熔炼而成的铁锭。可以用于制作作剑刃，盔甲
column3: An Iron Ingot smelted from Metal Fragments. Used to craft sword blades and armor.

column2: 掺杂了其他金属的铁合金。硬而脆，只能用作剑刃。
column3: An iron alloy mixed with other metals. Hard but brittle — only good for sword blades.

column2: 勉强入级的A1级金属，性能均匀
column3: An A1-tier metal that just barely qualifies; evenly balanced.

column2: 利用能力宝石打成的锭。这可不会被软上限..
column3: An ingot forged from power gems. This one isn't subject to the soft cap…

column2: 强度在A2级别的合金。鱼龙混杂的地宫材料导致它制作的护甲有毒，销路糟糕。此外，因快速的市场饱和，它的市场价还没有它材料的一半贵。
column3: An A2-tier alloy. The Crypt's motley materials make armor from it toxic and hard to sell. On top of that, rapid market saturation means it fetches less than half the price of its own ingredients.

column2: 由黑色刀币与魂魄重铸而成的金属。强度高达A4级——在血洛大陆，无用的物品不可能成为货币。
column3: A metal reforged from Black Knife Coins and souls. Strength as high as A4-tier — on the Bloodfall Continent, no useless thing could ever become currency.

column2: 注入了荒兽的活性成分之后，导能更加强大的柳木
column3: Willow that, infused with a Wildbeast's active essence, conducts energy far better.

column2: 可以通过多种手段熔炼的A6级合金。在清野江畔一带也很难找到更好的金属了。
column3: An A6-tier alloy that can be smelted several ways. Hard to find a better metal anywhere around Qingye Riverbank.

column2: 脉冲合金与浅蓝晶粉组成的A8级合金。拥有蓄能的特性。
column3: An A8-tier alloy of Pulse Alloy and Light Blue Crystal Powder. Has an energy-storing property.

column2: 模拟【缠绕骸骨】做成的剑柄部件。
column3: A sword-hilt part made in imitation of the 【Entwining Skeleton】.

column2: 结界湖中储量较大的A9级金属。因为生物富集作用，荒兽血肉中也含有大量这样的金属。
column3: An A9-tier metal abundant in Barrier Lake. Thanks to bioaccumulation, Wildbeast flesh also holds a lot of it.

column2: 利用绿色刀币铸成的B1级合金。或许是因为大人物偶尔也会用到，它基本无毒，可以用作盔甲。
column3: A B1-tier alloy cast from Green Knife Coins. Maybe because bigwigs use it now and then, it's basically non-toxic and can be made into armor.

column2: 雷电加护劈高能凝胶出现的稳定蜡状物。比起缠绕水晶导能性质一致，手感好得多。
column3: A stable, waxy substance formed when a Lightning Blessing strikes High-Energy Gel. Conducts energy just like Coiled Crystal, but feels far nicer to hold.

column2: 重甲残骸被红黑印记还原并加强后的金属。强度约为B2-B3。
column3: Metal from Heavy Armor Wreckage, restored and strengthened by a Red-Black Mark. Strength around B2–B3.

column2: 城主府统一作为奖励发放的合金。其中似乎富含Pt/Fe/Cs,还有一些法力能量用于调和。
column3: An alloy the Lord's Manor hands out uniformly as a reward. Seems rich in Pt/Fe/Cs, plus some mana energy to balance it.

column2: 使用兽角和荧光精华炼制出的合金。强度B6级，但不适于做盔甲...否则黑暗中自带发光索敌效果。
column3: An alloy refined from beast horns and Fluorescent Essence. B6-tier strength, but bad for armor… otherwise you'd glow in the dark and get targeted.

column2: 【冰原超流体】的相变产物。强度为B6级中上。
column3: The phase-change product of 【Ice Field Superfluid】. Upper-B6-tier strength.

column2: 被荧光精华注入的黑白枝丫。与精神念力更为适配，外表也更为顺滑。
column3: Black-White Branches infused with Fluorescent Essence. Better suited to psychokinesis, and smoother to the eye.

column2: 性质改良过的叶片。看起来不像是叶片了...不然喵可要变成野人了！
column3: Leaves with improved properties. They don't even look like leaves anymore… otherwise Neko would look like a savage!

column2: 无法继续被佩戴，只是用于合成【飞船之心】的临时解决方案。
column3: Can no longer be equipped — just a stopgap for crafting the 【Heart of the Spaceship】.

column2: 无法继续被佩戴，只是用于合成【冰原之心】的临时材料。
column3: Can no longer be equipped — just a temporary material for crafting the 【Heart of the Ice Field】.

column2: 无法继续被佩戴，只是用于合成【幻境之心】的临时材料。
column3: Can no longer be equipped — just a temporary material for crafting the 【Heart of the Illusory Realm】.

column2: 【万载冰髓】与冰宫中的镶嵌宝石结合成的合金。表面十分锋利，因此不适合制作盔甲。强度为B7+级。
column3: An alloy of 【Age-Old Frostmarrow】 and the Ice Palace's inlaid gems. Its surface is razor-sharp, so it's unsuited to armor. B7+ strength.

column2: 将万载冰髓打碎，研磨，注入能量回路中……冰元素固然寒冷刺骨，但广谱能量抵消的特性仍然使它值得作为材料。
column3: Age-Old Frostmarrow shattered, ground, and threaded into energy circuits… the ice element is bone-chilling, but its broad-spectrum energy cancellation still makes it a worthy material.

column2: 非常普通的冰块，在地宫都嫌便宜。完全就是建筑废料……
column3: A very ordinary Ice Block — too cheap even for the Crypt. Basically construction scrap…

column2: 水素晶体注入冰原超流体得到的合金。比起冰元素，水元素与它的相性更好。它的强度为B9-级。
column3: An alloy of Hydrogen Crystal infused into Ice Field Superfluid. It's more compatible with the water element than the ice element. B9- strength.

column2: 悬浮着的光环杖芯本就是不错的念力兵器材料，而虹彩凝胶的多种元素更使得兵器可以更加灵活。
column3: A floating Aura Staff Core is already fine material for a psychokinetic weapon, and Iridescent Gel's many elements make the weapon even more versatile.

column2: 引力异常的功率可不止于让绝音蕨自动漂浮！它可以打乱战斗区域的光线，让敌人手忙脚乱！
column3: A Gravity Anomaly's power does more than just float Silent Fern! It scrambles the light across the combat zone, throwing enemies into disarray!

column2:
吞噬星空的设定中，矿脉中会含有100ppm的【精】和10ppb的【母】，分别+1tier和+2tier。
因此，宝石锭是A1级，宝石母锭就是C1级了！
column3:
In Swallowed Star's lore, ore veins contain 100ppm 【Essence】 and 10ppb 【Matrix】, granting +1 and +2 tiers respectively.
So if Gem Ingot is A1-tier, Raw Gem Ingot is C1-tier!

column2: 吸收魂魄的紫晶锭。粗制器灵，但是更强了——境界越高的修者，死后的魂魄残留越多的灵性。
column3: An Amethyst ingot that has absorbed souls. A crude weapon-spirit, but stronger — the higher a cultivator's realm, the more spirituality their soul leaves behind at death.

column2:
凭它可以招揽冰蓝(出狱后突破至天空级巅峰)和秋兴(出狱后突破至天空级八阶)加入重组纳家！
别跟我说这东西上面该写个冰字。
否则我就狡辩血洛大陆通用语是象形文字！
column3:
With this you can recruit Binglan (who breaks through to Sky-Tier Peak after release) and Qiuxing (who breaks through to Sky-Tier Rank 8) into the rebuilt Na Family!
Don't tell me this thing ought to have the character for "ice" written on it.
Or I'll just argue that the Bloodfall Continent's common tongue is pictographic!

column2: 与大地有着天然的亲和……人话就是很重！砍人超级疼！
column3: A natural affinity with the earth… in plain words, it's heavy! Hits like a truck!

column2: 吸收了战场气息的金属。打人带破甲，也就是相当高的等效攻击！
column3: Metal that has soaked up Battlefield Aura. Its blows pierce armor — meaning a very high effective attack!

column2: 可以视为大大增强的活性织料。正如看起来的一样，能给不少回血~
column3: Think of it as greatly enhanced Reactive Cloth. Just as it looks, it heals quite a bit~

column2: 某种意义上是高级魂晶。但是混入了太多魂魄，所以穿在身上会造反！
column3: In a sense it's premium Soul Crystal. But too many souls got mixed in, so it'll rebel if you wear it!

column2: 爆燃粉末升华琥珀金骨，形成类似Raney Ni……串台了！总之倒进血灵液就可以用做轮芯了。
column3: Combustion Powder sublimates Amber Gold Bone into something like Raney Ni— wrong channel! Anyway, pour it into Bloodspirit Fluid and it's ready for use as a Wheel Hub.

column2: 也许有人好奇为什么这些百家精血的装备就不会造反了。其实是因为高温灭灵过了……
column3: Maybe you're wondering why this gear made from the Hundred Clans' refined blood doesn't rebel. It's because it was spirit-purged at high heat…

column2: 这一区虽然有茸茸和追光者……但凝胶的性质决定了它无法刻录稳定符文和法阵。这使凝胶类物品在C1级以上越来越不占优。
column3: This zone has Furballs and Light-Chasers… but the nature of Gel means it can't inscribe stable runes or arrays. That's why Gel-type items fall further behind past C1-tier.

column2: 普通的A1级金属矿石，可以使用毒液彻底炼化
column3: An ordinary A1-tier metal ore; can be fully refined using Venom.

column2: 真正的煤炭！吸收了部分能量的它，可以提供比魔力碎晶高得多的温度。
column3: Real coal! Having absorbed some energy, it provides a far higher temperature than Mana Crystal Shards.

column2: 荒兽森林中常见的大树木材。材质相当好，适合传导力量。
column3: Common large-tree lumber from the Wildbeast Forest. Quite fine material, good for conducting power.

column2: 结界湖的能量也无法改变鲤鱼不好动的天性。作为大地级六阶的鱼类，连潮汐级初等的修者都有机会把它拽上来。
column3: Not even Barrier Lake's energy can change a carp's sluggish nature. As an Earth-Tier Rank 6 fish, even a Tide-Tier Basic cultivator has a shot at hauling it up.

column2: 另一种结界湖鱼类。因为贪吃的食性而较为灵活，同等境界下需要费一番功夫才能捕捉。
column3: Another Barrier Lake fish. Its gluttony makes it agile; catching one of the same realm takes some effort.

column2: 结界湖中鱼王一般的存在。体型不大却极为难缠，传说曾经有过天空级冰柱鱼飞出水面的记录。
column3: A king among Barrier Lake's fish. Small but exceedingly tough — legend records a Sky-Tier Icicle Fish once leaping clear out of the water.

column2: 青花鱼的究极形态——天空级七阶。比起只会沉浮的鱼，学会了在二维平面移动……
column3: The ultimate form of the Mackerel — Sky-Tier Rank 7. Unlike fish that only bob up and down, it has learned to move across a 2D plane…

column2: 传说有误！结界能量太充沛了，冰柱鱼王突破到天空级巅峰 +了！这里最强的不会有3+境吧……虽然没资源突破不了云霄级就是了啦。
column3: The legend was wrong! The barrier's energy is too abundant — the Icicle Fish King broke through to Sky-Tier Peak+! Surely the strongest here isn't 3+ realms above… though without resources it can't break through to Skyhigh-Tier anyway.

column2: 绘制着最近新发现的一处藏宝地。(纳可已经记住地点，可以放心售卖)
column3: It maps out a recently discovered treasure site. (Neko has already memorized the location, so feel free to sell it.)

column2: 被完全涂黑了，只留下一句血洛大陆通用语的血书：牵制毁一生,匙弱穷三代。
column3: Completely blacked out, leaving only a line written in blood in the Bloodfall common tongue: "Restraint ruins your life; being weak beggars three generations."

column2: 没事...父亲大人进不去秘境。他肯定不知道是我偷偷把光环弄坏的！(持有时2-3与2-4 BOSS战光环-8%/个，不少于0%)
column3: It's fine… Father can't get into the Secret Realm. He surely doesn't know I secretly broke the Aura! (While held, -8% aura per copy in the 2-3 and 2-4 boss fights, down to no less than 0%.)

column2: 海量海绿锭和废墟符文雕刻成的工作台。[使用]此物品即可解锁T8工作台的使用！(对了，制作配方需要材料多的可怕，所以建议直接买)
column3: A workbench carved from a mountain of Seagreen Ingots and Ruins Runes. [Use] this item to unlock the T8 workbench! (By the way, the crafting recipe needs a terrifying amount of materials, so just buy it.)

column2:
使用多冲程压缩-膨胀来制冷的套件，附带隔热装置。
可用于生产万载冰髓与玄冰果实·觉醒。
具体使用方式详见左下角问号菜单！
column3:
A kit that cools via multi-stroke compression-expansion, with built-in insulation.
Used to produce Age-Old Frostmarrow and Mystic Ice Fruit · Awakened.
See the question-mark menu at the bottom-left for exact usage!

column2:
冰宫的女巫们已经把他的身上给搜干净了。当奴隶还能卖一点钱，但放走了等他对接货源收益更高！
PS:每血洛日0点刷新商品
column3:
The Ice Palace witches have already picked him clean. Selling him as a slave earns a bit, but letting him go and waiting for him to line up a supply chain pays more!
PS: Stock refreshes at 0:00 each Bloodfall day.

column2:
传承水晶的知识补全了被涂黑的书！虽然自己不应该用，但可以套路心魔……
实际效果:【压制·伪】判定 +1%牵制比重(上限100%/加权几何平均)
column3:
The Legacy Crystal's knowledge has restored the blacked-out book! You shouldn't use it yourself, but you can trick the Inner Demon with it…
Actual effect: 【Suppression · Pseudo】 check, +1% Restraint weighting (cap 100% / weighted geometric mean)

column2: 煮熟的年幼凶兽肉排。食用后每秒回复40点血量，持续60秒
column3: A cooked steak of young Ferocious Beast. On eating, restores 40 HP per second for 60 seconds.

column2: 虽然颜色很奇怪但是真的能吃！食用后每秒回复80点血量，持续60秒
column3: The color's weird but it's genuinely edible! On eating, restores 80 HP per second for 60 seconds.

column2: 潮汐级凶兽的肉。不仅可以回血，还可以增加少许领悟！
column3: Meat of a Tide-Tier Ferocious Beast. Not only heals, but also grants a little insight!

column2: 它并不十分好喝。悲哀的是，地宫怪物的肉口感更糟...
column3: Not very tasty. Sadly, the flesh of Crypt monsters tastes even worse…

column2: 可以短时间内大幅增强你的力量。嘛，就是有一点副作用...
column3: Greatly boosts your power for a short time. Well, with a few side effects…

column2: 大地级荒兽的肉。谢天谢地，地宫深处终于有有能吃的东西了。
column3: Meat of an Earth-Tier Wildbeast. Thank goodness — deep in the Crypt there's finally something edible.

column2: 大地级中期荒兽的肉。出了地宫之后，外面的荒兽好吃了不少。
column3: Meat of a mid Earth-Tier Wildbeast. Once out of the Crypt, the Wildbeasts outside taste a good deal better.

column2: 提供10%魔攻，代价是普攻倍率-10%。
column3: Grants 10% Magic Attack, at the cost of -10% Basic Attack Multiplier.

column2: 提供60%效果的牵制，上限为3倍增伤。
column3: Grants Restraint at 60% effect, up to a 3x damage increase.

column2: 可以进行0.8,1.2两段不对等打击，代价是1%流血效果。
column3: Allows an uneven two-hit strike of 0.8 and 1.2, at the cost of a 1% bleed effect.

column2: 将每回合受到伤害限制在生命上限的5%，代价是1%流血效果。
column3: Caps damage taken per turn at 5% of Health Cap, at the cost of a 1% bleed effect.

column2: 兰陵城探险者常备的药剂。似乎是用大锅炖出来的。
column3: A potion Lanling City explorers keep on hand. Seems to be stewed in a big cauldron.

column2: 兰陵城探险者常备的药剂。为什么用大锅炖呢...因为高能凝胶会把脆弱的炼金设备弄坏啦。
column3: A potion Lanling City explorers keep on hand. Why stew it in a cauldron? Because High-Energy Gel would wreck fragile alchemy equipment.

column2: 大地级后期荒兽的肉。比起鱼类，更大的优点是可以批量生产...
column3: Meat of a late Earth-Tier Wildbeast. Its bigger advantage over fish is that it can be mass-produced…

column2: 经过剧烈的提纯之后，对B5级以下都可以产生效力的药剂。只是持续时间大打折扣。
column3: After intense purification, a potion effective on anything below B5-tier. The duration just takes a big hit.

column2: 可以暂时通过让气血外放，抑制【散华】作用的药剂。为防止喝完暴毙，还附带了恢复气血的功能。
column3: A potion that temporarily vents your vital energy to suppress the 【Scattered Bloom】 effect. To keep you from dropping dead after drinking it, it also restores vitality.

column2: 将部分生命隐匿起来，从而增大生命的【容量】。
column3: Hides away part of your health, thereby increasing your health 【capacity】.

column2: 天空级初期荒兽的肉。和之前的肉都不一样，它是被油炸过的！
column3: Meat of an early Sky-Tier Wildbeast. Unlike all the meat before it, this one's deep-fried!

column2: 反弹75%伤害，无视防御还给敌人！代价是普攻倍率-20%，且反伤不能击杀敌人(会保留1血)
column3: Reflects 75% of damage back at the enemy, ignoring defense! At the cost of -20% Basic Attack Multiplier, and the reflected damage can't kill (leaves 1 HP).

column2: 如果敌人的攻击少于角色的2倍，角色受到的伤害减少(角色防御/敌人防御)的二分之一。反之，增加(角色防御/敌人防御)的两倍。该效果不会把伤害降低到0以下或提高到100倍以上。
column3: If the enemy's attack is less than 2x yours, damage you take is reduced by half of (your Defense / enemy Defense). Otherwise, it's increased by twice (your Defense / enemy Defense). This effect won't lower damage below 0 or raise it above 100x.

column2: 敌人的攻击被削弱(角色生命/敌人生命)^0.5 * 10(单位:%)，但会造成生命流失1%。该效果不会把敌方基础攻击降低到0以下。
column3: The enemy's attack is weakened by (your Health / enemy Health)^0.5 * 10 (unit: %), but you lose 1% health. This effect won't lower the enemy's base attack below 0.

column2: 基础攻击倍率变为10%，但每次命中以20% 30%...递增。长线战斗就选它！
column3: Base attack multiplier becomes 10%, but each hit ramps up by 20%, 30%, and so on. Pick it for long fights!

column2: 使用后随机获取5瓶B9级炼金药剂。
column3: On use, randomly grants 5 bottles of B9-tier alchemy potions.

column2: 被击碎的传承水晶·绿。是稀有的百分比恢复——别想囤几十万个！云霄级突破清buff的！
column3: A shattered Legacy Crystal · Green. A rare percentage-based heal — don't even think about hoarding hundreds of thousands! A Skyhigh-Tier breakthrough wipes buffs!

column2: 被击碎的传承水晶·蓝。绝对出乎意料的是，这个没有debuff！结界的一百纪元里，配方已经变得完美了呢。
column3: A shattered Legacy Crystal · Blue. Utterly unexpectedly, this one has no debuff! Over the barrier's hundred epochs, the recipe has been perfected.

column2: 类似于吞噬星空雾岛的那些东西，不过境界略高一筹。可以使用的同时它也是材料。
column3: Similar to those things on Swallowed Star's Misty Island, but a notch higher in realm. It can be used, and it's also a material.

column2: 虽然是心头血做的酱料，但毕竟含有磅礴的生命能量，肯定好吃就是了~
column3: The sauce is made from heart's blood, but it packs immense life energy, so it's definitely delicious~

column2: 其实……百分比恢复也不是那么危险的设计？
column3: Actually… is percentage-based healing really that dangerous a design?

column2: 古人埋在秘境里的东西。并没有那么稀有，毕竟这些补给品算是制式装备。
column3: Something the ancients buried in the Secret Realm. Not that rare, really — these supplies count as standard-issue gear.

column2: 毬毬山谷四处都是长这样的A3级普通鲜花。然而，根据吞噬星空定律，其中有0.01%的B3级爆血鲜花和亿分之一的C3级燃血鲜花……诺，就在这里啦！
column3: Furball Valley is covered in A3-tier ordinary flowers that look like this. However, by the Swallowed Star law, 0.01% are B3-tier Bloodburst Blossoms and one in a hundred million is a C3-tier Bloodflame Blossom… and there — right here it is!

column2: 比【燃血鲜花】高6阶的罕有天材地宝。强化效果和【燃血鲜花】不冲突，且略强一线。下区的【血峰之心】同样需要它。
column3: A rare natural treasure 6 ranks above the 【Bloodflame Blossom】. Its enhancement doesn't conflict with the 【Bloodflame Blossom】, and is a touch stronger. The next zone's 【Heart of Blood Peak】 needs it too.

column2: 涂抹了凝胶的飞蛾翅膀结合体，适合与皮肤亲密接触
column3: A composite of Moth Wings coated in Gel, suited for close skin contact.

column2: 用灵液将铜骨和天蚕丝融合的产物
column3: A product of fusing Copper Bone and Wild Silk with Spirit Fluid.

column2: 有一定生命活性的耐极端环境混合物。其类似物曾被用于制造【黑神】套装。
column3: A mixture with some biological activity that endures extreme environments. Its analog was once used to make the 【Black God】 set.

column2: 秘境芦苇的纤维被水溶精华分散，填充。传导能量，抵消攻击的能力有了巨大的提高。
column3: Secret Realm Reed fibers dispersed and filled out with Water-Soluble Essence. Its ability to conduct energy and offset attacks is hugely improved.

column2: 蕴含着大量待释放能量的粘性材料，在攻击袭来时首先可以抵消一部分。
column3: A sticky material holding a great deal of energy waiting to be released; when an attack comes, it offsets part of it first.

column2: 幻境符文/绝音蕨的两层吸收使得它几乎完成了光学隐身。什么叫外甲可以被看见？不要在意那些细节！
column3: The double absorption of Illusory Realm Rune and Silent Fern makes it nearly optically invisible. What do you mean the outer armor can still be seen? Don't sweat the details!

column2: 本身价值不算高昂，但却是第三幕最佳内甲的必备材料！
column3: Not worth much itself, but an essential material for Act 3's best inner armor!

column2: 它暗到似乎可以吸收周围的光。幻境阵法中多余的暗元素全数汇入了四重幻境，它就是受益者。
column3: So dark it seems to absorb the surrounding light. All the surplus dark element of the Illusory Realm's arrays flowed into the fourth-tier illusion, and it's the beneficiary.

column2: 可以强化力量的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷1点或生命50点
column3: A crystal that strengthens you; on use, randomly adds 1 Attack/Defense/Agility or 50 Health.

column2: 可以强化力量的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷2点或生命100点
column3: A crystal that strengthens you; on use, randomly adds 2 Attack/Defense/Agility or 100 Health.

column2: 可以强化力量的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷5点或生命250点
column3: A crystal that strengthens you; on use, randomly adds 5 Attack/Defense/Agility or 250 Health.

column2: 可以强化力量的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷10点或生命500点
column3: A crystal that strengthens you; on use, randomly adds 10 Attack/Defense/Agility or 500 Health.

column2: 高阶的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷20点或生命1000点
column3: A higher-tier crystal; on use, randomly adds 20 Attack/Defense/Agility or 1000 Health.

column2: 高阶的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷50点或生命2500点
column3: A higher-tier crystal; on use, randomly adds 50 Attack/Defense/Agility or 2500 Health.

column2: 高阶的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷100点或生命5000点
column3: A higher-tier crystal; on use, randomly adds 100 Attack/Defense/Agility or 5000 Health.

column2: 高阶的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷200点或生命1万
column3: A higher-tier crystal; on use, randomly adds 200 Attack/Defense/Agility or 10,000 Health.

column2: 极为珍贵的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷500点或生命2.5万
column3: An exceptionally precious crystal; on use, randomly adds 500 Attack/Defense/Agility or 25,000 Health.

column2: 极为珍贵的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷1000点或生命5万
column3: An exceptionally precious crystal; on use, randomly adds 1000 Attack/Defense/Agility or 50,000 Health.

column2: 极为珍贵的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷2000点或生命10万
column3: An exceptionally precious crystal; on use, randomly adds 2000 Attack/Defense/Agility or 100,000 Health.

column2: 极为珍贵的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷5000点或生命25万
column3: An exceptionally precious crystal; on use, randomly adds 5000 Attack/Defense/Agility or 250,000 Health.

column2: 普通人一生难得一见的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷1万或生命100万
column3: A crystal an ordinary person rarely sees in a lifetime; on use, randomly adds 10,000 Attack/Defense/Agility or 1e6 Health.

column2: 普通人一生难得一见的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷2万或生命200万
column3: A crystal an ordinary person rarely sees in a lifetime; on use, randomly adds 20,000 Attack/Defense/Agility or 2e6 Health.

column2: 普通人一生难得一见的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷5万或生命500万
column3: A crystal an ordinary person rarely sees in a lifetime; on use, randomly adds 50,000 Attack/Defense/Agility or 5e6 Health.

column2: 普通人一生难得一见的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷10万或生命1000万
column3: A crystal an ordinary person rarely sees in a lifetime; on use, randomly adds 100,000 Attack/Defense/Agility or 1e7 Health.

column2: 极端稀有的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷20万或生命2000万
column3: An extremely rare crystal; on use, randomly adds 200,000 Attack/Defense/Agility or 2e7 Health.

column2: 极端稀有的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷50万或生命5000万
column3: An extremely rare crystal; on use, randomly adds 500,000 Attack/Defense/Agility or 5e7 Health.

column2: 极端稀有的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷100万或生命1亿
column3: An extremely rare crystal; on use, randomly adds 1e6 Attack/Defense/Agility or 1e8 Health.

column2: 极端稀有的晶体，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷200万或生命2亿
column3: An extremely rare crystal; on use, randomly adds 2e6 Attack/Defense/Agility or 2e8 Health.

column2: 能引发天空级强者厮杀的宝物，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷500万或生命5亿
column3: A treasure that can set Sky-Tier powerhouses killing each other; on use, randomly adds 5e6 Attack/Defense/Agility or 5e8 Health.

column2: 能引发天空级强者厮杀的宝物，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷1000万或生命10亿
column3: A treasure that can set Sky-Tier powerhouses killing each other; on use, randomly adds 1e7 Attack/Defense/Agility or 1e9 Health.

column2: 能引发天空级强者厮杀的宝物，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷2000万或生命20亿
column3: A treasure that can set Sky-Tier powerhouses killing each other; on use, randomly adds 2e7 Attack/Defense/Agility or 2e9 Health.

column2: 能引发天空级强者厮杀的宝物，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷5000万或生命50亿
column3: A treasure that can set Sky-Tier powerhouses killing each other; on use, randomly adds 5e7 Attack/Defense/Agility or 5e9 Health.

column2: 虽然看起来是剑，但其实是血洛晶的一丝碎片，蕴含着强烈的杀戮能量！使用时必定增加攻击1亿。
column3: It looks like a sword, but it's really a sliver of Bloodfall Crystal, brimming with intense killing energy! On use, always adds 1e8 Attack.

column2: 仅仅一颗就可以掀起小范围的腥风血雨，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷1亿或生命200亿
column3: Just one can stir up a small-scale bloodbath; on use, randomly adds 1e8 Attack/Defense/Agility or 2e10 Health.

column2: 仅仅一颗就可以掀起小范围的腥风血雨，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷2亿或生命400亿
column3: Just one can stir up a small-scale bloodbath; on use, randomly adds 2e8 Attack/Defense/Agility or 4e10 Health.

column2: 仅仅一颗就可以掀起小范围的腥风血雨，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷5亿或生命1000亿
column3: Just one can stir up a small-scale bloodbath; on use, randomly adds 5e8 Attack/Defense/Agility or 1e11 Health.

column2: 仅仅一颗就可以掀起小范围的腥风血雨，使用时随机增加攻击/防御/敏捷10亿或生命2000亿
column3: Just one can stir up a small-scale bloodbath; on use, randomly adds 1e9 Attack/Defense/Agility or 2e11 Health.

column2: 从死去的史莱姆中发现的凝胶。可以用作缓冲垫，但并不耐用。
column3: Gel found in dead slimes. Works as a cushioning pad, but isn't durable.

column2: 损坏的普通金属片。已经无法用于制造剑盾，但或许还能重新熔炼？
column3: Damaged bits of ordinary metal. No longer usable for making swords or shields, but maybe they can be re-smelted?

column2: 一小块残留着魔力的水晶。内部的能量仍然足以烤肉或炼铁。
column3: A small crystal with residual mana. The energy inside is still enough to grill meat or smelt iron.

column2: 飞蛾留下的完整翅膀。可以用作衣服的材料
column3: An intact wing left by a moth. Can be used as clothing material.

column2: 燕岗城郊山上的大块石头，废弃傀儡和石头人也是它们制造的。
column3: Big rocks from the hills outside Yangang City; Abandoned Puppets and Stone Golems are made from them too.

column2: 微尘级凶兽的肉。散发着腥味，或许需要烤一烤？
column3: Meat of a Dust-Tier Ferocious Beast. Gives off a fishy smell — maybe grill it a bit?

column2: 一根粗大的骨头。光是拿着就感觉阴森森的..
column3: A thick, heavy bone. Just holding it feels eerie…

column2: 万物级骷髅死后留下的青铜骨头。它的硬度和韧性都很不错！
column3: Bronze bone left behind by an All-Things-Tier skeleton. Both its hardness and toughness are quite good!

column2: 万物级凶兽的肉。蕴含的气血充沛，价格略高。
column3: Meat of an All-Things-Tier Ferocious Beast. Rich in vital energy, priced a little higher.

column2: 傀儡身上的特殊金属，掺杂在铁锭中可以增强硬度
column3: Special metal from puppets; mixed into Iron Ingots, it increases hardness.

column2: 万物级异兽的皮毛，兼具硬度和韧性
column3: Hide of an All-Things-Tier Aberrant Beast, both hard and tough.

column2: 郊外常见的毒素集合体。A1级合金"紫铜"需要它作为原材料。
column3: A common cluster of toxins from the outskirts. The A1-tier alloy "Copper" needs it as a raw material.

column2: 潮汐级魔物的精华，具有多种优异性能。
column3: Essence of a Tide-Tier monster, with many excellent properties.

column2: 切叶虫茧的构建材料，蕴含有风元素。初步具有智慧的潮汐级凶兽也常常携带着它。
column3: The building material of a Leafcutter Cocoon, holding the wind element. Tide-Tier Ferocious Beasts with dawning intelligence often carry it too.

column2: 潮汐级凶兽的肉。蕴含有元素之力，没有煤炭火焰难以煮熟。
column3: Meat of a Tide-Tier Ferocious Beast. Holding elemental power, it's hard to cook without a Coal flame.

column2: 纯灵体荒兽体内的魂魄。经处理后可以成为纯净的能量。
column3: The soul within a pure-spirit-body Wildbeast. Once processed, it becomes pure energy.

column2: 大地级荒兽的眼球，可以作为生命恢复药剂的素材
column3: The eyeball of an Earth-Tier Wildbeast; can serve as an ingredient for health recovery potions.

column2: 部分"内丹"修炼体系荒兽体内的核心。可以在短时间内诱导出巨大的力量。
column3: The core within Wildbeasts of certain "inner-elixir" cultivation systems. Can draw out immense power in a short time.

column2: 荒兽使用的土制低劣武器。虽然本身易于断裂，但是它的潜力不止于此
column3: A crude, homemade weapon used by Wildbeasts. It breaks easily, but its potential goes beyond that.

column2: 地宫核心可以吃的荒兽肉！原来是能吃的荒兽都跑到核心去了嘛？
column3: Edible Wildbeast meat from the Crypt Core! So the edible Wildbeasts all ran off to the Core, huh?

column2: 可以耐受极寒与炙热的皮草，只能从大地级荒兽中获取
column3: A fur that withstands both extreme cold and searing heat; obtainable only from Earth-Tier Wildbeasts.

column2: 大地级流动怪物死后留下的凝胶。比起潮汐级以下的死物，它们仍然保有一定的活性。
column3: Gel left behind by Earth-Tier flowing monsters. Unlike dead matter below Tide-Tier, it still retains some activity.

column2: 在荒兽森林的战斗中，积累的战斗经验和突破感悟。(已弃用/现版本无法获取/请去找心之石像白嫖一颗突破)
column3: Combat experience and breakthrough insight gathered in the Wildbeast Forest. (Deprecated / unobtainable in the current version / go grab a free breakthrough from the Heart Stone Statue.)

column2: 对细碎战斗感悟整理而成的完整感悟，可以用于突破大地级或积累经验值。
column3: A complete insight assembled from scattered combat insights; usable to break through Earth-Tier or to accumulate XP.

column2: 作为以荒兽闻名的森林，这里的肉比地宫多多了...
column3: As a forest famed for its Wildbeasts, there's far more meat here than in the Crypt…

column2: 有坚硬外骨骼荒兽的甲壳碎片。用于熔炼A6级充能合金。
column3: Carapace shards from Wildbeasts with hard exoskeletons. Used to smelt the A6-tier Charged Alloy.

column2: 虽然它既不好吃还没有壳，但是它的心头血还是能量充沛的。
column3: It's neither tasty nor shelled, but its heart's blood is brimming with energy.

column2: 江边水生系荒兽的精华。可以用作魔法药剂的材料。
column3: Essence of riverside aquatic Wildbeasts. Can be used as material for magic potions.

column2: 纳家秘境里的一种柔性材料，可以吸收能量攻击，许多修行者和荒兽都会携带。
column3: A pliable material from the Na Family Secret Realm that absorbs energy attacks; many cultivators and Wildbeasts carry it.

column2: 某种更蓝一些的末影珍珠同位体。很遗憾，血洛大陆的传送没那么容易。
column3: A somewhat bluer isotope of the Ender Pearl. Sadly, teleportation on the Bloodfall Continent isn't so easy.

column2: 部分"灵"体内的能量结晶。可以在短时间内诱导出巨大的力量。
column3: The energy crystal within certain "spirits." Can draw out immense power in a short time.

column2: 威武武士就是靠这个变成威武异衣士的。出乎意料的，秘境里居然有高强金属！
column3: This is what turns a Mighty Warrior into a Mighty Exotic-Garb Warrior. Unexpectedly, the Secret Realm actually has high-strength metal!

column2: 比柳木更好一线的剑柄能量传导材料。唯一的缺点是过于坚硬，难以直接握住。
column3: A sword-hilt energy-conducting material a notch better than Willow. Its only flaw is being too hard to grip directly.

column2: 死水旁边的荒兽不能直接吃！但是可以用来铸造蓝金...
column3: Wildbeasts by the dead water can't be eaten directly! But they can be used to forge Blue Gold…

column2: 似乎蕴含着神奇的力量。积攒的足够多可以造出一台T8工作台...当然，直接买便宜多了。
column3: Seems to hold a wondrous power. Gather enough and you can build a T8 workbench… of course, just buying one is far cheaper.

column2: 从废墟中萌发的蓬勃生命力。可以与水火徽章形成共鸣，或者用于制造更多缠绕水晶。
column3: Vigorous life force sprouting from the Ruins. Can resonate with the Water-Fire Emblem, or be used to make more Coiled Crystal.

column2: 战场灵体生物体内的黑色凝胶。汇聚了能量，有多种用途。
column3: Black gel from within Battlefield spirit-body creatures. Full of gathered energy, with many uses.

column2: 虽然环境混乱不堪，但是抵达大地级后期的荒兽都拥有自我净化能力。即使是哥布林也能吃...
column3: The environment is utter chaos, but Wildbeasts that reach the late Earth-Tier all have a self-purifying ability. Even Goblins are edible…

column2: 你知道这是什么的，对吧？超进化·煤炭desu！
column3: You know what this is, right? Super-Evolution · Coal, desu!

column2: 制式重工机械体内的专属印记。可以用于在熔炼时增加金属的强度。
column3: The proprietary mark inside standard-issue heavy-industry machines. Used to increase metal strength during smelting.

column2: 阻激夹域机械体内的一缕电属性痕迹。法则属性几乎为0，但已足以固化高能凝胶。
column3: A wisp of lightning-attribute residue inside Pincer-Field mechs. Its Law attribute is nearly 0, but enough to solidify High-Energy Gel.

column2: 飞船冒险者留下的铠甲。尚未被红黑印记增幅。
column3: Armor left by spaceship adventurers. Not yet amplified by a Red-Black Mark.

column2: 中等宇宙国度的货币。按宇宙币计价大约只有200Z的价值，但在血洛大陆相当有收藏意义。
column3: Currency of a mid-sized cosmic nation. In Cosmic Coins it's worth only about 200Z, but on the Bloodfall Continent it has real collector's value.

column1: 进化结晶凝聚-一学就会
column2: 因为一学就会，你已经学会了。可以卖掉它了！(请检查核心反应堆)
column3: Since it's learn-at-a-glance, you've already learned it. You can sell it now! (Please check the Core Reactor.)

column2: 天地间充沛的能量滋养诞生的晶体，接触后能够化作海量的经验为人所用。增加1000亿经验值，可用于突破【天空级】。(Tips:即必须在已有9000亿以上经验时使用才能突破)
column3: A crystal born of the abundant energy of heaven and earth; on contact it turns into a vast amount of XP for you. Adds 1e11 XP; usable to break through to 【Sky-Tier】. (Tip: you must already have 9e11+ XP when using it to break through.)

column2: 稀有且常常破碎的能量晶体，纳可借助狗王之腹方才凝聚成一颗完整的。增加10京经验值，可用于突破【云霄级】。(Tips:即必须在已有90京以上经验时使用才能突破)
column3: A rare and often-shattered energy crystal; Neko only managed to condense a whole one with the help of the Dog King's belly. Adds 1e17 XP; usable to break through to 【Skyhigh-Tier】. (Tip: you must already have 9e17+ XP when using it to break through.)

column2: 天地间充沛的能量滋养诞生的晶体碎片，接触后能够化作海量的经验为人所用。增加1000兆经验值，或等待【第四幕】合成【中等进化结晶】突破云霄级。
column3: A crystal shard born of the abundant energy of heaven and earth; on contact it turns into a vast amount of XP for you. Adds 1e15 XP, or wait for 【Act 4】 to craft an 【Intermediate Evolution Crystal】 and break through to Skyhigh-Tier.

column2: 飞船核心机械的冷却剂。可以拆分为100个普通高能凝胶。
column3: Coolant for Spaceship Core machinery. Can be split into 100 ordinary High-Energy Gels.

column2: 飞船核心机械的能量源。可以拆分为100个普通B1·能量核心。
column3: Power source for Spaceship Core machinery. Can be split into 100 ordinary B1 · Energy Cores.

column2: 强烈建议不要卖掉。【结界湖之心】在V3.0X将会超过好不容易省下的姐姐，而重铸一颗飞船核心非常昂贵...
column3: Strongly advise against selling it. In V3.0X the 【Heart of the Barrier Lake】 will surpass the sister you scrimped so hard to save, and reforging a Spaceship Core is very expensive…

column2: 击杀【天空级初期】荒兽的证明。可以用于在沼泽入口兑换材料。一只荒兽只会有一份，但人可能有更多...
column3: Proof of killing an 【early Sky-Tier】 Wildbeast. Can be redeemed for materials at the swamp entrance. One Wildbeast yields only one, but a person might have more…

column2: 或许会因为进化过快有辐射。但天空级完全可以无视这些杂乱的能量了~
column3: It may be irradiated from evolving too fast. But a Sky-Tier can completely ignore this messy energy~

column2: 沼泽天然发光体的遗物。它的荧光可以驱散常年不散的瘴气。
column3: Remnant of the swamp's natural luminous bodies. Its glow can dispel the miasma that never lifts.

column2: 虽然卖相不好，却是荧光精华想要长期发光不可或缺的补给品。它还有一些邪恶的用法..
column3: It looks unappealing, but it's an indispensable supply for keeping Fluorescent Essence glowing long-term. It also has some wicked uses…

column2: 黑暗森林中荒兽的角。被原能浸润过了，是合金的好材料。
column3: The horn of a Dark Forest Wildbeast. Soaked in primal energy, it's fine alloy material.

column2: 如果放进核心反应堆会导致瞬间爆炸。这样不稳定的燃料需要更可靠的反应堆。
column3: Putting it in the Core Reactor would cause an instant explosion. Such unstable fuel needs a more reliable reactor.

column2: 很遗憾，它们不是超巨大的宝石。不过，它们拥有【念力操控】属性..
column3: Sadly, they aren't colossal gems. Still, they have the 【Psychokinetic Control】 attribute…

column2: 看似很小其实又大又厚。在恰当的处理后可以做成更好的织料。
column3: Looks small but is actually big and thick. With proper processing it makes better cloth.

column2: 空气是热的不良导体。虽然冰原气体似乎不是氮氧混合物，但不妨碍它成为良好的隔热材料。
column3: Air is a poor conductor of heat. The Ice Field's gas doesn't seem to be a nitrogen-oxygen mix, but that doesn't stop it from being good insulation.

column2:
热容类似水，冰点类似氦。
在吸收足量冰元素之后会相变为万载冰髓……
正如其名，此转化在冰原常温[240K]下大约需要一个纪元。
column3:
Heat capacity like water, freezing point like helium.
After absorbing enough ice element it phase-changes into Age-Old Frostmarrow…
As its name implies, at the Ice Field's ambient temperature [240K] this conversion takes about one epoch.

column2:
冷却到足够低温后会凝结出一颗冰霜核心。
需要在【极寒相变引擎】中散热给【冰原超流体】！
column3:
Cooled low enough, it condenses a Frost Core.
It needs to shed heat into 【Ice Field Superfluid】 within the 【Deepfrost Phase-Change Engine】!

column2: 冰宫中的高级盾牌，镶嵌着特殊的晶体。可以用于和万载冰髓锭形成合金！
column3: A high-grade shield from the Ice Palace, set with special crystals. Can be alloyed with Age-Old Frostmarrow Ingot!

column2: 并不全是龙鳞，只要可以剥皮的敌人身上都会有。没有它的话会被万载冰髓冻死的……
column3: Not all dragon scales — any skinnable enemy has them. Without it, Age-Old Frostmarrow would freeze you to death…

column2: 女巫构建的稳定微型能量回路。可以持续向外转化光环能量，也可用于调和不同性质的力量。
column3: A stable micro energy-circuit built by the witches. It steadily converts aura energy outward, and can also harmonize powers of different natures.

column2: 颜色更加深邃而内敛了。或许云霄级的核心会有一个惊喜？
column3: The color has grown deeper and more restrained. Maybe a Skyhigh-Tier core holds a surprise?

column2: 和那个只值几十个铜板的兄弟不同，它的彩色来源于多种元素的力量，因此价值不菲。
column3: Unlike its cousin worth only a few dozen Copper Coins, its color comes from the power of many elements, so it's far from cheap.

column2: 这个水素不是hydro-gen，而是水元素啦……或者你也可以当它是无人深空那个二氢晶体？
column3: This "hydrogen" isn't hydro-gen — it's the water element… or you could treat it as that Dihydrogen crystal from No Man's Sky?

column2: 左阿传承的一部分。一种与幻境阵法核心相连的水晶，能量输出比能量核心稳定许多。
column3: Part of Zuo'a's legacy. A crystal linked to the core of the Illusory Realm's arrays; its energy output is far more stable than an Energy Core's.

column2: 左阿传承的一部分。单纯锋利而闪光的水晶。
column3: Part of Zuo'a's legacy. A simply sharp and glittering crystal.

column2: 左阿传承的一部分。蕴含大量生机的水晶，加强热以提取能量。
column3: Part of Zuo'a's legacy. A crystal full of vitality; heat it to extract energy.

column2: 左阿传承的一部分。蕴含大量虚浮力量的水晶。
column3: Part of Zuo'a's legacy. A crystal holding a great deal of buoyant power.

column2: 左阿传承的一部分。看似杂乱无章，实际上却含有大量能量回路的水晶。
column3: Part of Zuo'a's legacy. A crystal that looks chaotic but actually contains a great many energy circuits.

column2: 保留完整能量回路，自动吸收天地间能量的魂魄。放置数年也不会丢失记忆。
column3: A soul that keeps its full energy circuit and automatically absorbs the energy of heaven and earth. It won't lose its memories even left for years.

column2: 蓝金的上位金属。晶莹剔透，具有容纳灵魂的潜质。
column3: Blue Gold's superior metal. Crystal-clear, with the potential to hold souls.

column2: 由纳可的水火领域外溢的能量衍生的符文。巨型结界的作用可不是盖的！
column3: A rune derived from energy overflowing Neko's Water-Fire Domain. The giant barrier's power is no joke!

column2: 天外飞船到底是怎么飞进血洛的？这就是答案了！
column3: Just how did the Alien Spaceship fly into Bloodfall? Here's your answer!

column2: 城门战的参与令牌。天空级小队也有一人一颗，所以爆的更多！
column3: A token for entering the City Gate Battle. Even Sky-Tier squads carry one each, so more of them drop!

column2: 好吧。看起来只是变得更加大只和鲜艳了。总感觉它已经开始不稳定了……
column3: Well. It just looks bigger and more vivid. Somehow it feels like it's already starting to destabilize…

column2: 怎么GregTech也干了啊！言归正传……死线的5倍伤害太op了。削弱之道，就在其中~
column3: GregTech went and did it too?! Anyway… Deadline's 5x damage is way too OP. The way to nerf it lies right in here~

column2: 本是被击碎的B5级普通金属，但在数纪元前的古战场中吸收了海量斗战气息，得到了巨大的强化。
column3: Once shattered B5-tier ordinary metal, but on an ancient battlefield epochs ago it absorbed a vast amount of battle-aura and was greatly strengthened.

column2: 云霄级敌人的精血。治疗效果很强，当然当酱料蘸也是可以的。
column3: The refined blood of Skyhigh-Tier enemies. Strong healing effect — though you can also use it as a dipping sauce, sure.

column2: 为什么只有荒兽不能杀了吃肉呢？好吧可以吃的。之所以掉率那么低是因为只有核心的一小块有云霄级别能量……
column3: Why is it that only Wildbeasts can't be killed for meat? Fine, it's edible. The drop rate's so low because only a small piece at the core holds Skyhigh-Tier energy…

column2: 比起天空级的，多出了双层结构，存续时间大大提升。当然，古墓都几个纪元了，再怎么坚韧最初的那些魂魄也消散了，这些都是探险者的魂魄。
column3: Compared to the Sky-Tier kind, it has a double-layered structure and lasts far longer. Of course, the ancient tomb is epochs old — however tough, the earliest souls have long dispersed, so these are all explorers' souls.

column2: 正在从银骨向金骨转化的云霄级荒兽骨头，目前转化进度72.2%。这绝对不是舞萌rating后三位之类的数字！
column3: Bone of a Skyhigh-Tier Wildbeast midway from silver bone to gold bone, currently at 72.2% conversion. This is absolutely NOT the last three digits of a maimai rating or anything!

column2: 瞬间的高温可以升华琥珀金骨，在膨胀冷凝后，生成物又可以辅助琥珀金骨凝为纤维状……
column3: Its instant high heat can sublimate Amber Gold Bone; after expansion and condensation, the product can in turn help Amber Gold Bone set into fibers…

column2: 极致坚硬的云霄级荒兽皮肤。呈红色是因为融入了部分精血，因此也成为了上等的炼器材料。
column3: The supremely hard skin of a Skyhigh-Tier Wildbeast. It's red because some refined blood merged into it, which also makes it top-grade artifact-forging material.

column2: 刻录许多自增幅符文的布匹，对基因原能和精神念力都有一定比例的增幅作用……至少在它饱和之前。
column3: Cloth inscribed with many self-amplifying runes; it boosts both genetic primal-energy and psychokinesis by a set proportion… at least until it saturates.

column2: 按照冰元素密度来看，已经达到了【万载冰髓精】的级别。也不知道山谷里是怎么出现的这些冰属性荒兽——难道还有其他秘境？
column3: By ice-element density, it's already reached the 【Age-Old Frostmarrow Essence】 grade. No idea how these ice-attribute Wildbeasts showed up in the valley — is there another Secret Realm?

column2: 已经凝聚【冰霜核心】的玄冰果实。可用于合成【冰原之心】(可进化装备)，也可直接食用获取10兆经验。
column3: A Mystic Ice Fruit that has already condensed a 【Frost Core】. Usable to craft the 【Heart of the Ice Field】 (an evolvable piece of gear), or eat it directly for 1e13 XP.

column2: 燕岗领铸造的通用钱币
column3: Common currency minted by the Yangang Fief.

column2: 燕岗领铸造的通用钱币，面值5C
column3: Common currency minted by the Yangang Fief, face value 5C.

column2: 完整，色彩鲜艳的凝胶。能卖个好价钱！
column3: Intact, vividly colored gel. It'll fetch a good price!

column2: 燕岗领铸造的通用钱币，面值100C
column3: Common currency minted by the Yangang Fief, face value 100C.

column2: 血洛大陆的通用钱币，面值1X=1000C
column3: Common currency of the Bloodfall Continent, face value 1X = 1000C.

column2: 血洛大陆的通用钱币。1Z=1000X=1'000'000C.
column3: Common currency of the Bloodfall Continent. 1Z = 1000X = 1,000,000C.

column2: 包装起来的血洛大陆通用钱币。总面值10Z。
column3: Bundled Bloodfall Continent currency. Total face value 10Z.

column2: 血洛大陆的通用钱币。1D=1000Z。值得一提的是，它有两把剑，可以铸成两锭海绿。
column3: Common currency of the Bloodfall Continent. 1D = 1000Z. Worth noting: it has two blades, and can be forged into two Seagreen ingots.

column2: 血洛大陆的通用钱币。1B=1000D。宝石制成的它相当珍贵，甚至有微弱增强气运的功效。
column3: Common currency of the Bloodfall Continent. 1B = 1000D. Made of gemstone, it's quite precious — it even faintly boosts fortune.

column2: 全宇宙通用的货币。1U=1000B。界主强者在突破时会凝聚海量宇宙晶，切成小块即为富含能量的宇宙币。
column3: Currency accepted across the whole universe. 1U = 1000B. World-lord powerhouses condense vast Cosmic Crystals on breakthrough; cut into small pieces, these become energy-rich Cosmic Coins.

column2: 一大堆宇宙币，共计1000U(或记为1kU)
column3: A big heap of Cosmic Coins, totaling 1000U (or written 1kU).

column2:
堆成小山的宇宙币，共计1000000U(或记为1MU).
对了，按1000U=1m^3和30°堆积休止角，它们可以堆成高4.73m半径8.20m的圆锥。
实际上宇宙币不可能无缝堆积，所以堆起来更大……
column3:
Cosmic Coins piled into a small mountain, totaling 1,000,000U (or written 1MU).
By the way, at 1000U = 1m³ and a 30° angle of repose, they'd form a cone 4.73m tall with an 8.20m radius.
In reality Cosmic Coins can't pack seamlessly, so the pile would be even bigger…

column2: 血钻制造的【月轮】镀层。对于这样性质的材料来说，镀层和镶嵌的定义或许有些模糊？
column3: A 【Moonwheel】 plating made of Blood Diamond. For a material of this nature, the line between plating and inlay is maybe a little blurry?

column2: 血钻听起来不像是能熔炼成锭的金属的样子。但是，有什么斥力，和云霄级大锤子说去吧！
column3: Blood Diamond doesn't sound like the sort of metal you could smelt into an ingot. But whatever repulsive force it has, take it up with a Skyhigh-Tier sledgehammer!

column2: 呼……被这股气息笼罩着，感觉神智都清明了不少。(持有时每个将4-5区域光环-20%,最多生效5个)
column3: Phew… wrapped in this aura, your mind feels a good deal clearer. (While held, each one lowers the 4-5 zone aura by 20%; up to 5 take effect)

column2: 让暴风雨(和掉落物)来的更猛烈一些吧！。(持有时每个将4-5区域光环*(1+20%*sqrt(数量)),最多生效990025个)
column3: Let the storm (and the drops) rage harder! (While held, they multiply the 4-5 zone aura by (1+20%*sqrt(count)); up to 990025 take effect)

column2: 角色每次攻击延迟被击中敌人攻击1/2轮，但攻速*0.7.
column3: Each of your attacks delays the struck enemy's attack by 1/2 a round, but Attack Speed *0.7.

column2: 角色敏捷乘以1+血量比例/40%(满血即为3.5倍),但生命流失1%.
column3: Your Agility is multiplied by 1+health ratio/40% (3.5x at full health), but you lose 1% of your Health.

column2: 角色无视敌人攻击力超出防御力部分的50%，但普攻倍率*0.4.
column3: You ignore 50% of the amount by which an enemy's Attack exceeds your Defense, but Basic Attack Multiplier *0.4.

column2: 角色对敌人造成的伤害乘以1.25*(角色攻防和)/(敌人攻防和).加强的原因是你攻防和都超出敌人了还需要这个buff吗!
column3: Damage you deal to enemies is multiplied by 1.25*(your Attack+Defense)/(enemy's Attack+Defense). It got buffed because — if your Attack and Defense both already exceed theirs, do you even need this one!

column2: 红温了……看起来距离爆炸不远了哇。领域级之后经过坍缩，意识和能量并入原核，就无法再获取这些能量核心了。
column3: Glowing red-hot… looks like it isn't far off exploding. Past Domain-Tier they collapse, mind and energy merging into the primal core, and these energy cores can no longer be obtained.

column2: 灰暗领的小队在长期作战中凝结的军魂，即使小队因减员解散，军魂也可维持大半纪元不灭。
column3: An army soul congealed by a Dusk Territory squad over long campaigning; even after the squad disbands from losses, the soul endures undimmed for the better part of an era.

column2: 海量精血经过特殊手法淬炼出的精华，蕴含着血洛晶同源的能量。分量大约在0.0001Δ，但因驳杂价值远低于此。
column3: An essence refined from a vast quantity of blood-essence by a special method, holding energy of the same origin as Bloodfall Crystal. It weighs roughly 0.0001Δ, but being impure it is worth far less than that.

column2: 散发着温和的气息，仿佛能让狂暴的荒兽都平静下来。
column3: It gives off a gentle aura, as though it could calm even a raging wild beast.

column2: 散发着暴戾的气息，仿佛能让荒兽突破极限，二次进化。
column3: It gives off a violent aura, as though it could push a wild beast past its limit into a second evolution.
